rules.IDF: Ask date of birth, then the last four digits of the mobile number.
rules.IDW: Two wrong answers in total end the identity check.
rules.CAL: Business days are Monday to Friday except the listed closing days.
rules.CB: A callback is today or one of the next two business days, 09:30 to 18:30 inclusive, and later than now.
rules.DL: Each product's deadline is the Nth business day after today, N from its band (early 10, middle 6, late 3).
rules.FL: The floor is min_due for a store card, repayment_amount for a cash loan, contract_instalment for motor finance.
rules.ATT: Persuasion attempts after the opening ask are 1, 2, 3 for early, middle, late; the opening ask does not count.
rules.LAD: Ladder: full amount on the next business day; then max(half rounded down to the euro, floor) on the deadline; then the floor on the deadline; no repeated offer.
rules.NOTE: Each product ending without a commitment gets one note with its code; no notes on a transfer.
rules.CLOSE: Close codes follow the closing table.
rules.XFER: Restructure requests transfer to queue restructure, insisted requests for a person to queue operator.
